Title: [VCST-5028] Admin/Support Org-Membership Remediation: Unlock One-Org Membership via Admin SPA Widget -> REST Verify -> Global Account Untouched
Preconditions:

Fixture: @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.email) has TWO org memberships -- TechFlow (org-maintainer) and BuildRight (org-employee).
BuildRight membership is PRE-LOCKED via REST before this case runs (Setup step below sets the locked state).
PLAT-084 covers the distinct-mechanism check; this case extends it to the full Admin SPA unlock flow and cross-layer REST + global-account verification.
Steps:
--- LAYER: Setup (pre-lock BuildRight membership via REST) ---
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.buildright_membership_id)/lock (admin token)
[STATUS] 200 -- BuildRight membership pre-locked
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/search body {userId: @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId)} -- verify BuildRight isLocked=true
--- LAYER: Admin SPA Widget ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{BACK_URL}} > Customers > Contacts
[BLADE] Contacts blade open
[ACT] Search for @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.email) in contacts search field
[ACT] Open contact detail blade for @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.email)
[BLADE] Contact detail blade open
[ACT] Scroll to Organization Memberships widget (VCST-5028)
[ASSERT] [BLADE] Organization Memberships widget visible with two rows: TechFlow and BuildRight
[ASSERT] [GRID] BuildRight row shows locked/blocked status indicator
[ASSERT] [GRID] TechFlow row shows active/unlocked status (org-isolation -- lock is org-specific)
[ACT] Locate the BuildRight membership row in the widget
[ACT] Click Unlock / Unblock action for the BuildRight row
[WAIT] Success toast or row state update
[ASSERT] [GRID] BuildRight row status changes to Active/Unlocked in the widget
[ASSERT] [GRID] TechFlow row status unchanged (still Active)
--- LAYER: REST Verification ---
[HTTP POST] {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/search body {userId: @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId)}
[STATUS] 200
[BODY] BuildRight membership (organizationId=@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.org_buildright_id)) isLocked=false
[BODY] TechFlow membership (organizationId=@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.org_techflow_id)) isLocked=false
--- LAYER: Global Account Guard ---
[HTTP GET] {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId)/locked
[STATUS] 200
[BODY] {locked: false} -- ApplicationUser global account NOT locked at any point in this flow (BL-AUTH-012: org-lock and org-unlock MUST NOT modify ApplicationUser.LockoutEnd)
Assertions:
[BLADE] Organization Memberships widget shows two rows with correct org names
[GRID] BuildRight row: locked status before unlock; active status after unlock
[GRID] TechFlow row: active/unlocked throughout (not affected by BuildRight lock/unlock)
[STATUS] REST search: BuildRight isLocked=false after Admin SPA unlock (AC3 propagation)
[BODY] TechFlow isLocked=false (cross-org isolation preserved)
[BODY] Global account guard: GET .../locked returns {locked: false} (BL-AUTH-012)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/search body {userId: @td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId)} -> TechFlow isLocked=false, BuildRight isLocked=false after Admin SPA unlock
[API] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId)/locked -> {locked: false} (global ApplicationUser unaffected throughout)
[VERIFY] Admin SPA Organization Memberships widget state matches REST search response (no stale widget cache)
Failure_Signals: Organization Memberships widget absent in Admin SPA contact blade (VCST-5028 widget not rendered -- regression); unlock action missing for BuildRight row (widget shows locked state but no unlock affordance); Admin SPA unlock sets ApplicationUser.LockoutEnd=9999 instead of org-scoped IsLocked=false (BL-AUTH-012 violation -- critical); TechFlow row shows locked after only BuildRight was locked (org-isolation regression); REST search still shows BuildRight isLocked=true after Admin SPA unlock (propagation failure)
Cleanup:
[SAVE] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.buildright_membership_id)/unlock -- restore BuildRight membership to unlocked state if test did not complete
[SAVE] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.techflow_membership_id)/unlock -- defensive unlock for TechFlow
